title: Large Language Models Transform Organic Synthesis From Reaction Prediction to Automation
abstract: arXiv:2508.05427v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are beginning to reshape how organic-synthesis workflows are represented, queried, planned, and connected to experimental automation. Assessing their contribution is not straightforward because reaction-specific transformers, chemistry-adapted LLMs, tool-using agents, optimizers, and autonomous laboratories are often discussed under the same broad terminology despite operating at different levels of the synthesis workflow. This Review traces the progression from reaction prediction and retrosynthetic planning to reaction development, literature-to-protocol translation, and robotic execution, with representative numerical claims verified against primary sources available through 4 September 2026. translated_title: 大语言模型变革有机合成：从反应预测到自动化
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）正在开始重塑有机合成工作流的表示、查询、规划以及与实验自动化的连接方式。评估它们的贡献并不简单，因为反应专用Transformer、化学适应型大语言模型、工具调用智能体、优化器和自主实验室常常在同一宽泛的术语下被讨论，尽管它们在合成工作流的不同层面运作。本综述追溯了从反应预测和逆合成规划到反应开发、文献到实验方案转化以及机器人执行的演进过程，其中的代表性数值结论均通过与2026年9月4日之前可获取的原始文献核对进行了验证。我们考察了语言模型在哪些方面提供了真正的附加价值，既有专业方法在哪些方面仍然是性能的主要来源，以及检索、不确定性感知优化、确定性化学……（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本综述系统梳理了大语言模型在有机合成全流程中的应用演进——从反应预测、逆合成规划到反应开发、文献方案转化及机器人自动化执行，并客观评估了语言模型相对于传统专业方法的真实价值与局限。
en_tdlr: This review traces how large language models are reshaping the entire organic synthesis workflow—from reaction prediction and retrosynthetic planning to reaction development, literature-to-protocol translation, and robotic automation—while critically assessing where LLMs provide genuine added value over established specialist methods.
